title: Russian Drone Strikes SBU Headquarters in Central Kyiv — First Direct Hit of the War, Injuring 12
detail: A Russian drone struck the headquarters of Ukraine's Security Service (SBU) on Volodymyrska Street in central Kyiv, opposite St. Sophia's Cathedral, around 3:30 p.m. local time on September 4 — the first known Russian attack directly on the SBU's central headquarters building in the four-and-a-half-year war. The drone appeared aimed at the office of acting SBU chief Oleksandr Poklad, who was unharmed. At least 12 people were injured, with Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko saying 9 were hospitalized, 2 in serious condition; the strike damaged the building's exterior wall and nearby historic structures at the Sofia Kyivska complex. President Zelensky said Ukraine had already determined the 'geography' of a retaliatory response and would choose the timing for maximum effect.

title: Ukrainian Drones Strike Russian Defense and Petrochemical Plants in Bashkortostan, 1,300 km From Ukraine
detail: Ukrainian FP-1 drones struck the Sterlitamak Petrochemical Plant and the Avangard Federal State Enterprise in Bashkortostan's Sterlitamak on the morning of September 4 — a facility more than 1,300 km from Ukraine. The petrochemical plant produces aviation fuel and materials used by Russia's defense industry and has now been struck at least three times since November 2025; Avangard is a sanctioned Russian military-industrial enterprise manufacturing explosives, ammunition, and containers under state defense orders. The strike triggered a fire and an evacuation of staff; local Telegram channels reported the attack while Bashkortostan authorities acknowledged a drone strike on the industrial zone without initially naming the facilities hit.
